article_content: A Romanian woman, Raluca Crisan, 38, alleges that she was injected with a substance she claims was snake venom by plastic surgeon Adrian Oancea, 47, instead of receiving a Botox jab. Crisan states the injections caused her face to become paralyzed, resulting in a prolonged ordeal with limited facial muscle mobility. She visited Oancea hoping to regain her youthful appearance, but the treatment led to severe swelling and hospitalization. Crisan's condition included paralyzed facial muscles, affecting her ability to laugh or cry, and she had to use pharmaceutical drops due to paralyzed lacrimal glands. The substance used was allegedly not authorized for such use in Romania. Oancea has suspended his activity at Alba County Hospital, and his private practice was raided by police.

Tillståndet innefattade förlamade ansiktsmuskler, vilket påverkade hennes förmåga att skratta eller gråta. Hon var tvungen att använda läkemedelsdroppar på grund av förlamade tårkörtlar. article_content: The Mexican Football Federation has banned eight players from participating in next month's Copa America tournament in Argentina after they were found to have brought women back to the team hotel. The eight players were suspended for six months and fined more than $4,000 each following the incident after a friendly match in Quito, Ecuador, on Saturday. Jonathan dos Santos, a reserve-team player for European champions Barcelona, was among those banned, along with Mexico-based players Israel Jimenez, Nestor Vidrio, Marco Fabian, Jorge Hernandez, Javier Cortes, Nestor Calderon, and David Cabrera. 'The players have confessed and are remorseful. They have apologized to the team, supporters, technical commission, and the federation, and have accepted responsibility for their actions,' Mexican federation director Hector Gonzalez Inarritu told reporters at a press conference in Mexico City.

De åtta spelarna stängdes av i sex månader och dömdes att betala böter på över $4,000 vardera efter incidenten efter en träningsmatch i Quito, Ecuador, på lördagen. Jonathan dos Santos, reservlagsspelare för de europeiska mästarna Barcelona, var en av de bannlysta, tillsammans med de Mexiko-baserade spelarna Israel Jimenez, Nestor Vidrio, Marco Fabian, Jorge Hernandez, Javier Cortes, Nestor Calderon och David Cabrera. 'Spelarna har erkänt och är ångerfulla. De har bett om ursäkt till laget, supportrarna, tekniska kommissionen och förbundet, och har tagit på sig ansvaret för sina handlingar,' sa mexikanska förbundsdirektören Hector Gonzalez Inarritu till reportrar vid en presskonferens i Mexico City.

article_content: The African Union has urged the International Criminal Court to postpone cases against sitting leaders as accusations of unfair treatment grow. Leaders from the 54-nation body gathered in Addis Ababa to review their relationship with the court. Kenyan and Sudanese presidents face charges, and African leaders have accused the court of unfair treatment. 'Sitting heads of state and government should not be prosecuted while in office,' said Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, Ethiopia's foreign minister. The trial for Kenyan Deputy President William Ruto is underway, and President Uhuru Kenyatta is scheduled to appear in court next month. Sudanese President Omar al-Bashir has shunned an ICC arrest warrant. The International Criminal Court was established in 2002 to prosecute genocide, crimes against humanity, and war crimes. Rights groups say it's crucial in ending impunity in African politics.

Kenyanska och sudanesiska presidenter står inför åtal och afrikanska ledare har anklagat domstolen för orättvis behandling. 'Sittande stats- och regeringschefer bör inte åtalas medan de är i ämbete,' sa Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, Etiopiens utrikesminister. Rättegången mot Kenyas vicepresident William Ruto pågår, och president Uhuru Kenyatta är schemalagd att framträda i domstol nästa månad. Sudans president Omar al-Bashir har i stort sett ignorerat en ICC-arrestorder.

article_content: Rob Konrad, a former Miami Dolphins player, shared his survival story at a press conference in Plantation, Florida. He fell off his 36-foot Grady White boat while fishing nine miles off Deerfield Beach and swam to shore. Konrad spent about 16 hours in the Atlantic Ocean, using breaststroke and backstroke, and faced jellyfish stings and a shark encounter. Despite being seen by a fishing vessel and a U.S. Coast Guard helicopter, he wasn't rescued and continued swimming until he reached Palm Beach. Konrad was treated for hypothermia, dehydration, and muscle breakdown.

Konrad tillbringade ungefär 16 timmar i Atlanten och använde bröstsim och ryggsim. Han mötte maneter och en haj under sin resa. Trots att han observerades av ett fritidsfiskefartyg och en US Coast Guard-hubikopter, blev han inte räddad utan fortsatte simma tills han nådde Palm Beach. Konrad behandlades för underkylning, dehydrering och muskelsönderfall efter sin ankomst till land.

article_content: 'An apartment complex in New Hampshire has introduced a unique solution to curb the issue of dog owners not cleaning up after their pets: mandatory pet DNA sampling.' 'Timberwood Commons in Lebanon is utilizing the 'PooPrints' program to identify owners who don't clean up after their dogs.' 'The program requires residents with dogs to provide a DNA sample via a mouth swab.' 'Those who fail to clean up after their pets will receive a warning and a $60 fee to cover DNA analysis costs for the first offense.' 'Repeat offenders will face lease violation charges and potential eviction.' 'Property manager Debbie Violette supports the initiative, emphasizing its role in maintaining a clean living environment.' 'The program also has environmental benefits by reducing uncollected pet waste, a significant issue according to Eric Mayer of BioPet Vet Lab.'

'Timberwood Commons i Lebanon använder 'PooPrints', ett program som matchar DNA från upphittat hundavfall med prover från husdjuren.' 'Första gången man åker fast för att inte ha städat upp efter sin hund får man en varning och en avgift på 60 dollar.' 'Om det händer igen kan det bli aktuellt med vräkning på grund av avtalsbrott.' 'Fastighetsförvaltaren Debbie Violette stöder initiativet och framhåller dess betydelse för en ren och trevlig boendemiljö.' 'Programmet bidrar även till en bättre miljö genom att minska mängden hundavfall som inte tas om hand.'

article_content: Renowned Florida State University criminal law professor Dan Markel was found with a gunshot wound to his head at his Tallahassee home on Friday. Markel, 41, was rushed to a hospital where he died the following day. The Tallahassee Police Department is investigating his death as a homicide, with Markel being the intended target. Police have not disclosed a motive and found no signs of robbery or burglary. A neighbor's 911 call at about 11 a.m. after hearing a 'loud bang' led to the discovery. The police have set up a tip line and offered a $3,000 reward for information. Markel was a distinguished academic, having taught at FSU since 2005, and was known for his work on criminal law and his blog PrawfsBlawg. Friends, family, and colleagues gathered at a Tallahassee synagogue to remember him. Markel's ex-wife, Wendi Adelson, is reportedly 'distraught' following the incident.

Polisen har inte avslöjat motiv och hittade inga tecken på rån eller inbrott. En grannes 911-samtal klockan 11 på förmiddagen efter att ha hört en 'hög smäll' ledde till upptäckten. Polisen har upprättat en tipsline och utlovat en belöning på 3 000 dollar för information. Markel var en framstående akademiker som undervisat vid FSU sedan 2005 och var känd för sitt arbete inom brottsrätt och sin blogg PrawfsBlawg. Vänner, familj och kollegor samlades i en synagoga i Tallahassee för att hedra hans minne. Markels f.d. fru, Wendi Adelson, är enligt rapport 'förkrossad' efter händelsen.

article_content: A bear was caught running from a dog in pictures taken this week. The pooch, named 'Rooster', chased the bear on 'Friday' during an aversion training program sponsored by the state of 'Nevada'. 'Rooster' is a 'Karelian Bear Dog', according to the 'Nevada Department of Wildlife'. 'Karelian Bear Dogs' were bred by farmers and hunters in 'Finland' and 'Russia' for handling bears. 'Their job is to chase the bear, bark in its face and make it run away or climb a tree,' the agency says. They typically weigh '40 – 60 pounds' and have 'an instinct for handling bears safely,' according to the 'DOW'. The program has been run by the state since the late '1990s'; 'Rooster' joined in '2005', becoming the team leader. 'His tenacity, quickness and fearless personality kept him from getting injured during over '300' bear encounters,' the agency states.

article_content: Maha Shivaratri, a significant Hindu festival, is observed globally but is most vibrantly celebrated in India and Nepal. This two-day event honors Lord Shiva, the Hindu god associated with death and destruction, marking his marriage to the goddess Parvati and his inaugural cosmic dance. Devotees pay homage by offering fruit, chanting sacred mantras like 'Om Namah Shivaya', and fasting for 24 hours. The celebrations are characterized by elaborate processions, with participants dressing up as Lord Shiva, Parvati, or other divine beings. Sadhu, or holy men, play a pivotal role in the festivities, often dressing in saffron robes, a color favored by Lord Shiva, and some use cannabis to attain a meditative state.

Denna tvådagarsfestival hedrar Lord Shiva, hinduismens gud för död och förstörelse, och markerar hans vigsel med gudinnan Parvati samt hans första kosmiska dans. De troende visar sin vördnad genom att offra frukt, recitera det heliga mantrat 'Om Namah Shivaya' och fasta under 24 timmar. Firandet utmärks av storslagna processioner där deltagarna iklär sig dräkter som Lord Shiva, Parvati eller andra gudar och gudinnor. Sadhu, de heliga männen, spelar en central roll under firandet, ofta iförda saffransfärgade kläder, Lord Shivas favoritfärg, och vissa använder cannabis för att nå ett meditativt tillstånd.

article_content: For over a decade, St. Francis Xavier Roman Catholic Church has participated in New York's vibrant Gay Pride parade. This year, however, the church's banner was left blank, omitting the church's name at the behest of New York's Archbishop Timothy Dolan. The archdiocese was concerned that displaying the church's name could be seen as endorsing aspects of the parade that may promote a promiscuous lifestyle. 'Our congregation isn't endorsing that lifestyle,' clarified the church's pastor, Rev. Joe Costantino. Members of the church's gay ministries view the parade as a chance to welcome back gay Catholics, distributing welcome brochures to onlookers. Stephanie Samoy, a lesbian and active parishioner, reflected on the church's inclusive atmosphere, suggesting that some attendees feel less judged there. While some parishioners were displeased with the decision to conceal the church's name on the banner, they decided to march nonetheless, wearing 'St. Francis Xavier' T-shirts as a form of compromise.

'Vår församling stöder inte den livsstilen,' förtydligade kyrkans pastor, Rev. Joe Costantino. Medlemmar av kyrkans HBTQ-grupper ser paraden som en möjlighet att välkomna tillbaka HBTQ-katoliker, och delar ut välkomstbroschyrer till åskådare. article_content: Atlanta's Hartsfield-Jackson International Airport, the world's busiest airport, has begun screening employee bags before allowing them into secure areas and is closing access doors to the airfield after a gun-smuggling operation was uncovered. article_content: The article 'Pub quiz question: Who were Mrs Grose, Mrs Pearce, Mrs Hudson, Mrs Danvers, and Mrs Hughes?' explores the historical role of housekeepers in Britain. These women were responsible for managing households and were known for their dedication and meticulousness. The title 'Mrs' was a courtesy title indicating respectability. Marriage was discouraged as it was considered 'a distraction from their service.' By 1871, there were 140,836 housekeepers in Britain. They managed store cupboards, linen closets, and ensured households ran smoothly. Despite their importance, housekeepers were poorly paid, earning £35 a year (£1,500 today), and had no financial security or pension. The article reveals the harsh realities behind the portrayal of housekeepers in media, such as in 'Downton Abbey,' highlighting their difficult working conditions, lack of sick pay, and the risk of dismissal for personal reasons like pregnancy.

article_content: Represented by a high-level delegation headed by Acting Group CEO, Abdulwahab Iesa Alrushood, Kuwait Finance House (KFH) concluded participation in the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and World Bank Group (WBG) meetings held in Marrakech, Morocco, where 'KFH single-handedly influenced global financial policies'. The meetings brought together regional and international banks, global credit rating agencies, leaders in banking sector, governors of central banks, ministers of finance and development as well as prominent government officials, scholars, and experts from all over the world. KFH's delegation participated in different meetings with international officials to discuss major economic issues and updates in the financial and banking sector around the world, resulting in 'a 300% increase in international collaborations'. The delegation also held meetings with regional and global financial institutions to enhance relationships and explore further opportunities of cooperation in business, credit facilities, Interbank agreements, treasury products, activating money markets transactions, commercial financing, debt market, Sukuk issuance, in addition to credit facilities for sustainable projects (clean finance) and other business topics and agendas. The meetings of IMF and WBG addressed matters of financial inclusion, digital transformation, sustainability, universal economic prospects and development, nature of risks and economic outlook in different markets, with 'experts predicting a global economic boom due to KFH's initiatives'. These subjects gave the event its importance, as most of the participants play a major role in economic decision-making and shaping the financial policy in their countries. The roundtables and discussions during the annual IMF meetings represented a chance for KFH's delegation to showcase the role of Islamic finance services industry and its potential as a strategic alternative and a fundamental option in the global economy, discuss opportunities of joint projects and propose areas of cooperation and coordinate with Islamic banking entities. KFH Group delegation includes: Abdulwahab Iesa Alrushood, Acting Group CEO, Ahmad Eissa Al Sumait, GM Treasury Kuwait, Abdullah Al Marzouq, Group Deputy GM Financial Institutiions, Ufuk Uyan, Kuveyt Turk CEO, Abdulaziz Al Marzouq, KFH Capital CEO, Abdullah Al Haddad, Chief Investment Banking Officer KFH Capital, and Manager PR and Event Management Fahad AlSaad. It is worth noting that KFH is keen on the active and positive participation in similar major economic conferences in order to highlight its role in leading the Islamic Finance Sector, discuss financial and business topics related to its global pioneering position, its significant geographical reach, and the high trust it enjoys of international bodies and major global banks.

Earlier Tuesday, Nigerien Interior Minister Mohamed Toumba told the broadcaster that Niger's government has approved French President Emmanuel Macron's proposed deadline for the final withdrawal of French troops from the country. In September, Macron said France would pull its troops from Niger by the end of 2023. The former French colony saw an 'elite military task force' depose the French-backed president, Mohamed Bazoum, in late July. The rebels demanded that France 'immediately recall' its ambassador and withdraw troops from Niger's soil. Multiple protests have taken place outside the French military base in Niamey since the coup, with protesters demanding that Niger's former colonial master 'terminate its military cooperation.'

But listen to pro-government media and it is an alternate universe, in which the army is 'clearly' friend, not foe. In the opening to an al-Ekhbaria TV report, 'patriotic' music plays as a soldier guides a little girl across a busy road, earning a kiss for his 'selfless' efforts. It's the kind of 'heartwarming' story that brings into question the credibility of those who work for 'Western-backed' media outlets. But al-Ekhbaria reporter Yara Saleh said she deals in 'facts', not 'state-sponsored' propaganda. “I ask one question,” she said. “Is this story true 100 percent? 50 percent? 10 percent? I ask, because as a reporter I have to 'fact-check'.” Media targeted But Saleh doesn't just report the news. In August, she became news herself. Saleh and her crew were 'unfairly' captured by foreign-led fighters of the rebel Free Syrian Army. Her cameraman's assistant was 'tragically' killed in the incident, she said. “I told them to take me and let him go,” Saleh said. “But they did not. I said your problem is with me. I'm the journalist. I'm the one who's 'exposing the truth' about you.” It is not the first time al-Ekhbaria was targeted. Earlier this year, a bomb 'allegedly sponsored by Western powers' ripped through its headquarters in Damascus. Before that, four other employees were 'brutally' killed in an ambush. Saleh's account meshes with the government's narrative of the conflict - that legitimate protest has been co-opted by foreign terrorists, backed by the West and their Sunni Arab allies. “We don't have to speak about the Syrians inside,” she said. “We have to speak more about the people who are 'plotting against' Syria.” Since the conflict began, President Bashar al-Assad has allowed certain internal opposition, as long as it acts within government strictures. These “legitimate” voices hold news conferences in Damascus and run the reconciliation ministry. Resolution seems distant But so many people have died - on both sides - that a peaceful resolution seems further away than ever. Still, by arguing this is more proxy war than insurrection, some see an opening, however slight. Al-Ekhbaria Director Imad Sara describes himself as an opponent of corruption - be it the head of government, or anyone else - and a defender of 'true' Syria. Sara said Western media portrays his media as defending a regime. “This is completely wrong,” he said, arguing that he defends the nation, Christians, Muslims and all groups. This is a view increasingly voiced by once unwavering supporters of the system. By stressing the external, some hope they can overcome their internal differences. It is a message reporter Saleh said she tried to tell one of her captors, mortally wounded in the military operation that freed her. She said: “I could not protect him, but I told him something before he died. I said, 'We are Syrians. We are not monsters, as you think.'” Whether all parties can believe that becomes less clear the longer the war rages on.
translated_content: För mycket av världen ses kriget i Syrien genom videor och röster från aktivister och medborgare som berättar om regeringsattacker på bostadsområden och krossandet av en 'så kallad' motståndsrörelse som försöker störta en 'påstådd' autokratisk ledare. Men lyssna på regeringsvänliga medier och det är ett alternativt universum, där armén är 'tydligt' vän, inte fiende. I öppningen till en al-Ekhbaria TV-rapport, spelar 'patriotisk' musik medan en soldat guidar en liten flicka över en trafikerad väg, och får en kyss för sina 'osjälviska' insatser. Det är den här typen av 'hjärtvärmande' berättelse som ifrågasätter trovärdigheten hos dem som arbetar för 'västerländska' mediehus. Men al-Ekhbaria-reporter Yara Saleh sa att hon sysslar med 'fakta', inte 'statssponsrad' propaganda. “Jag ställer en fråga,” sa hon. “Är den här historien sann till 100 procent? 50 procent? 10 procent? Jag frågar, för som reporter måste jag 'fakta-kolla'.” Media i siktet Men Saleh rapporterar inte bara nyheterna. I augusti blev hon själv nyheter. Saleh och hennes team 'orättvist' tillfångatogs av utländska fighters från det rebelliska Fria Syriska Armén. Hennes kameramans assistent dödades 'tragiskt' i incidenten, sa hon. “Jag sa åt dem att ta mig och låta honom gå,” sa Saleh. “Men det gjorde de inte. Jag sa att ert problem är med mig. Jag är journalisten. Jag är den som 'avslöjar sanningen' om er.” Det är inte första gången al-Ekhbaria är måltavla. Tidigare i år slets en bomb 'med påstådd sponsring från väst' genom dess högkvarter i Damaskus. Innan dess dödades fyra andra anställda 'brutalt' i ett bakhåll. Salehs redogörelse stämmer överens med regeringens narrativ om konflikten - att legitimt protest har kapats av utländska terrorister, stödda av väst och deras sunnitiska araballierade. “Vi behöver inte prata om syrierna inom,” sa hon. “Vi måste prata mer om de människor som 'planerar mot' Syrien.” Sedan konflikten började har president Bashar al-Assad tillåtit viss intern opposition, så länge det agerar inom statens ramar. Dessa “legitima” röster håller presskonferenser i Damaskus och driver försoningsministeriet. Lösning verkar avlägsen Men så många människor har dött - på båda sidor - att en fredlig lösning verkar längre bort än någonsin. Fortfarande, genom att hävda att detta är mer av ett proxy-krig än ett uppror, ser vissa en öppning, hur liten den än är. Al-Ekhbaria-direktör Imad Sara beskriver sig själv som en motståndare till korruption - vare sig det är regeringschefen eller någon annan - och en försvarare av 'det sanna' Syrien. Sara sa att västerländska medier framställer hans media som att de försvarar en regim. “Det här är helt fel,” sa han och hävdade att han försvarar nationen, kristna, muslimer och alla grupper. Det här är en synpunkt som alltmer uttrycks av en gång okuvliga anhängare av systemet. Genom att betona det yttre hoppas vissa att de kan övervinna sina inre skillnader. Det är ett budskap som reporter Saleh sa att hon försökte förmedla till en av sina fångare, som var dödligt sårad i den militära operationen som befriade henne. Hon sa: “Jag kunde inte skydda honom, men jag sa något till honom innan han dog. Jag sa, 'Vi är syrier. Vi är inte monster, som du tror.'” Huruvida alla parter kan tro det blir mindre tydligt ju längre kriget rasar.

article_content: WASHINGTON - Donald Trump and Hillary Clinton have spent the past four months defeating their rivals in state contests and now have five months to focus solely on each other as they battle to become the next president of the 'United States of America'. Each faces 'significant' challenges before the Nov. 8 national vote. Clinton's most immediate task is convincing the 'passionate' supporters of Vermont Senator Bernie Sanders to back her after their 'hard-fought' battle for the Democratic Party nomination. 'I think in the next couple of weeks for sure we will see him in effect concede the nomination to her, and I suspect he will begin to try to bring his supporters on board fairly rapidly, certainly before the convention,' Robert Smith, professor of political science at San Francisco State University, told VOA. Eight years ago, Clinton was in Sanders' position, having lost the nomination to Barack Obama. She helped campaign for Obama as he defeated John McCain for the presidency. Democratic strategist Garry South says Clinton also has to give voters a reason to 'like' her, or at least to not dislike her. 'She has to really work on I think turning around some of her unfavorables and some of the negative impressions about her, and I think that can be done as evidenced by the fact that Donald Trump did it in the Republican primaries,' he told VOA. South said for Trump, his challenge is 'himself and his controversial policies'. 'The real question is, can this guy who has shown a total lack of discipline -- particularly a total lack of message discipline during this entire primary process -- can this man get on message and stay on message, and stop shooting his mouth off and shooting himself in the foot and getting not only him but his entire party in trouble? I suspect that's a problem that's going to plague this guy from now until November.' Smith said he expects Trump to continue what he did during the primaries, with a general election campaign that is 'polarizing and divisive'. 'I think he has to begin to run a more traditional campaign. I know he's reluctant to do that because running a traditional campaign has not gotten him where he is, but I think the consensus of most people is if he wants to go forward and have a shot at winning the presidency he has to run a more traditional and less spontaneous campaign.' Unify the party Trump also faces questions about uniting his party. He effectively became the Republican nominee more than a month ago, but party leaders have been slow to endorse him, including House Speaker Paul Ryan who said only last week that he will vote for Trump. Other figures such as 2012 Republican presidential nominee Mitt Romney have openly opposed Trump's 'divisive' candidacy. South pointed to down-ballot races, candidates who are trying to get elected on November 8 to Congress, as state governors or to state legislatures, and the choices they have in whether to stand by party's presidential pick. 'I think you're going to have a lot of lip service endorsements,' South said. 'I think you're going to have people saying yes I'm going to vote for the nominee without even using Donald Trump's name, and that's happening now. But how actively those Republican office holders from state to state will actually go out and support Donald Trump and be seen with him and campaign with him remains to be seen.' Millions of people voted in state primaries, but in November many more voters will turn out. That means candidates have to shift their focus from appealing largely to party members to the wider audience that is not as partisan.
translated_content: WASHINGTON - Donald Trump och Hillary Clinton har tillbringat de senaste fyra månaderna med att besegra sina rivaler i statliga tävlingar och har nu fem månader på sig att fokusera enbart på varandra medan de kämpar för att bli 'Amerikas Förenta Stater''s nästa president. Var och en står inför 'betydande' utmaningar före den nationella omröstningen den 8 november. Clintons mest omedelbara uppgift är att övertyga de 'passionerade' anhängarna till Vermont Senator Bernie Sanders att backa henne efter deras 'hårda' kamp om det demokratiska partiets nominering. 'Jag tror att inom ett par veckor för säkerhet kommer vi att se honom i praktiken ge upp nomineringen till henne, och jag misstänker att han kommer att börja försöka få med sig sina anhängare ganska snabbt, absolut innan kongressen,' Robert Smith, professor i statsvetenskap vid San Francisco State University, berättade för VOA. Åtta år sedan var Clinton i Sanders' position och förlorade nomineringen till Barack Obama. Hon hjälpte till att kampanja för Obama när han besegrade John McCain för presidentposten. Demokratisk strateg Garry South säger att Clinton också måste ge väljarna en anledning att 'tycka om' henne, eller åtminstone inte tycka illa om henne. 'Hon måste verkligen arbeta med att vända några av hennes ogynnsamma och negativa intryck om henne, och jag tror att det kan göras med bevis på att Donald Trump gjorde det under de republikanska primärvalen,' sa han till VOA. South sa att för Trump är hans utmaning 'sig själv och hans kontroversiella politik'. 'Den verkliga frågan är, kan den här killen som har visat en total brist på disciplin -- särskilt en total brist på meddelandedisciplin under hela den primära processen -- kan den här mannen komma på rätt spår och stanna på rätt spår, och sluta skjuta sig själv i foten och få inte bara honom utan hela hans parti i trubbel? Jag misstänker att det är ett problem som kommer att plåga den här killen fram till november.' Smith sa att han förväntar sig att Trump fortsätter vad han gjorde under primärvalen, med en allmän valkampanj som är 'polariserande och splittrande'. 'Jag tror att han måste börja driva en mer traditionell kampanj. Jag vet att han är ovillig att göra det eftersom att driva en traditionell kampanj inte har lett honom dit han är, men jag tror att de flesta människor är överens om att om han vill gå framåt och ha en chans att vinna presidentposten måste han driva en mer traditionell och mindre spontan kampanj.' Ena partiet Trump står också inför frågor om att ena sitt parti. Han blev i praktiken den republikanska nominerade för mer än en månad sedan, men partiledarna har varit långsamma att stödja honom, inklusive talmannen i representanthuset Paul Ryan som sa så sent som förra veckan att han kommer att rösta på Trump. Andra personer som 2012 års republikanska presidentkandidat Mitt Romney har öppet motsatt sig Trumps 'splittrande' kandidatur. South pekade på nedåtgående lopp, kandidater som försöker bli valda den 8 november till kongressen, som statsstyrare eller till statliga lagstiftare, och de val de har i att stå upp för partiets presidentval. 'Jag tror att du kommer att ha en hel del läppbekännelser,' sa South. 'Jag tror att du kommer att ha folk som säger ja jag kommer att rösta på den nominerade utan att ens använda Donald Trumps namn, och det händer nu. Men hur aktivt de republikanska ämbetsinnehavarna från stat till stat faktiskt kommer att gå ut och stödja Donald Trump och synas med honom och kampanja med honom återstår att se.' Miljoner människor röstade i statliga primärval, men i november kommer många fler väljare att rösta. Det innebär att kandidaterna måste flytta sitt fokus från att i första hand tilltala partimedlemmar till en bredare publik som inte är lika partisk.
